scope: static parity input dataflow classification and blocker reporting
changes: The readiness report now verifies exact consumer, input and output command tokens for K1, K4 and K5 before accepting their static isolated-file binding.
K2 and K3 are explicitly classified as external_or_live_input_blocked with machine-readable blocker reasons.
A drift test proves that changing the real K1 consumer input breaks the static file binding even when all parity hook markers remain present.
Static file binding does not set runtime origin, real behavior readiness or acceptance counters.
blockers: The three static isolated-file bindings have not been run and therefore have no independent runtime execution or artifact origin evidence.
Standalone K2 depends on live stream source activity and standalone K3 depends on external delivery or notification state; neither has an authorized comparable common real file input.
The read-only legacy 92 workflow artifacts do not contain the v1 manifest.
